objective.talk: Find Mira by the luminous greenhouse
objective.till: Till three patches of star-dusted soil ({0}/3)
objective.grow: Sleep in the cottage and keep them watered ({0}/2 nights)
objective.return: Bring the Starbuds back to Mira
objective.complete: Tend the farm or explore Luminfield beyond the southern gate
dialogue.mira.name: Mira
dialogue.mira.offer: The field remembers every gentle hand. Take these Starbud seeds—three blooms will be enough to wake its first light.
dialogue.mira.planting: Turn the dark soil with the Stardust shovel, plant the seeds, and give them water before you sleep. Their glow grows one night at a time.
dialogue.mira.growing: They are listening beneath the soil. Water them each day, then rest in the cottage when you are ready.
dialogue.mira.harvest: The Starbuds are awake. Gather three while their light is still soft.
dialogue.mira.return: You did it. Luminfield has answered you—and this is only its first whisper.
dialogue.mira.complete: The field is brighter with you here.
